question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the released `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py` helper, or treat it as obsolete now that current main directs skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between release compatibility for a shipped helper and the newer current-main skill-creation direction that removed that helper.

options.title: Treat the helper as obsolete
options.body: Close or redirect this issue and the linked PR because current main no longer exposes the helper and documents `skill_workshop` as the supported path.

options.title: Repair the released helper
options.body: Revive or backport case-insensitive parsing for `init_skill.py` with focused parser tests if maintainers still consider that helper a supported release surface.

recommendation.title: Treat the helper as obsolete
recommendation.body: Close or redirect this issue and the linked PR because current main no longer exposes the helper and documents `skill_workshop` as the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the bundled skill-creator helper and is the best history-backed owner for the supported-surface decision.
